grade.primary_choice: Build it in the Rails monolith as a namespaced admin area, with heavy reads on a replica
red_flags_hit: Missing CSV/formula injection when exporting customer-controlled strings that will be opened in Excel
unsupported_claims: Refers to a 'web dyno' (Heroku term) when the team runs on ECS Fargate
Assumes a 'checkout' customer path that the situation never mentions
'an hour of work' for the query prototype is an unbacked estimate
grade.notes: A strong, well-grounded answer: it builds in the monolith, uses a read replica, rollups, pg_trgm, Sidekiq exports to S3, audit logging and namespacing, and gives a solid list of things to check first; auth/SSO and rate limits get only light coverage. Its only clear miss is CSV formula injection, plus a couple of small factual slips (dyno, checkout).
